review: RC25 connection probe versus semantic completion and fallback
conclusion: HTTP probe success does not establish semantic backend identity. Metadata is compatible with fallback or same-candidate format repair; T17 remains unverified.

boundaries.fact: llm.test selects the specified provider directly; probe accepts any 2xx without parsing answer text or usage.
model.complete sorts candidates by requested catalog class before preserving profile order within each rank. UI primary alone does not establish first attempted candidate.

HTTP envelope parse/no-text failures are send errors, allowing fallback before any format repair except timeout. Content JSON/schema failures are accept errors with at most one same-candidate repair when usage is fully known.

attempts=2 and estimated=true can arise either from posted failure then fallback success, or known-usage invalid content then a valid repair response with missing usage. No provider identity is returned.

next_verification.proposal: Root may extract only existing MODEL_FORMAT_ERROR and MODEL_RETRY fixed-marker lines for a known isolated request window. A correctly attributed pair supports same-candidate repair; absent lines are inconclusive if logging/correlation completeness is unknown. Do not collect bodies, headers, routes, profile, keys, or full logs.

Reuse verified tests/complete.rs Fake, Fixed, Rig and Options.providers/transport injection with synthetic candidates and no real network/profile. Compare malformed 2xx envelope -> candidate B success against valid envelope/invalid content with full usage -> same candidate A repair success without usage. Both should yield attempts=2, estimated=true; fake captured candidate/model sequence discriminates paths. Add a 2xx malformed-envelope probe-versus-parser check and retain requested-class ordering check.

Offline fixtures establish control flow only. Existing app-facing metadata cannot prove actual GPT identity. Keep T17 unverified unless an already-authorized host-internal evidence source can tie the accepted request to the target provider. Do not remove backups, alter production config, add an invented pinned-provider API, or expand Host routing architecture.
